title: Exodus Chapter 19 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Exodus chapter 19 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Exodus Chapter 19 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Exodus Chapter 19.

questions.question: In which month did the children of Israel arrive at the wilderness of Sinai?
questions.correctAnswer: Third month
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:1 states that in the third month, the children of Israel came into the wilderness of Sinai.

questions.question: From which place had the children of Israel departed before coming to Sinai?
questions.correctAnswer: Rephidim
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:2 mentions that they had departed from Rephidim before arriving at the desert of Sinai.

questions.question: Who went up unto God to receive instructions for the children of Israel?
questions.correctAnswer: Moses
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:3 states that Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called to him from the mountain.

questions.question: How did the LORD describe carrying the children of Israel to Himself?
questions.correctAnswer: On eagles' wings
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:4 says God bore them on eagles' wings and brought them unto Himself.

questions.question: What condition did God give for Israel to be a peculiar treasure unto Him?
options: If they obey His voice and keep His covenant
questions.correctAnswer: If they obey His voice and keep His covenant
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:5 says if they obey God's voice and keep His covenant, they shall be a peculiar treasure unto Him.

questions.question: What did God say Israel shall be unto Him if they obey?
options: A kingdom of priests and a holy nation
questions.correctAnswer: A kingdom of priests and a holy nation
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:6 indicates they shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.

questions.question: Who did Moses call to lay before them all the words the LORD commanded?
questions.correctAnswer: The elders of the people
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:7 says Moses called for the elders of the people and laid before them all the LORD's words.

questions.question: What was the people's response when Moses told them God's words?
options: They said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do
questions.correctAnswer: They said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:8 records that all the people answered together, agreeing to do all the LORD had spoken.

questions.question: How did the LORD say He would come to Moses so the people might hear Him?
questions.correctAnswer: In a thick cloud
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:9 states that the LORD would come to Moses in a thick cloud so the people would hear when He spoke with Moses.

questions.question: True or False: The people of Israel camped before the mount of Sinai after departing from Rephidim.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:2 confirms that Israel camped before the mount after departing from Rephidim.

questions.question: True or False: Moses was commanded to tell the children of Israel to build a tabernacle immediately upon arrival at Sinai.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: The chapter does not mention building a tabernacle at this point; Moses was told to relay God's covenant and instructions instead (Exodus 19:3-6).

questions.question: True or False: God said all the earth belongs to Him.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:5 includes God's declaration that all the earth is His.

questions.question: True or False: The LORD told Moses that He would come upon the mount in the sight of all the people on the third day.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:11 states the LORD will come down upon mount Sinai in the sight of all the people on the third day.

questions.question: Which instruction came first in Exodus 19?
options: Tell the children of Israel they shall be a kingdom of priests
Sanctify the people and let them wash their clothes
Set bounds around the mount to prevent people from touching it
Moses calls the elders to lay before them the LORD's words
questions.correctAnswer: Tell the children of Israel they shall be a kingdom of priests
questions.explanation: The command to tell Israel they shall be a kingdom of priests appears in Exodus 19:6, before the sanctification, setting bounds, or calling elders which occur later.

questions.question: What did Moses tell the people to do to prepare for the third day?
options: Wash their clothes and be sanctified
questions.correctAnswer: Wash their clothes and be sanctified
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:10-14 directs Moses to sanctify the people and have them wash their clothes to be ready for the third day.

medium.title: Exodus Chapter 19 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Exodus Chapter 19 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Exodus 19:10-11, what specific actions did the LORD command Moses to instruct the people to do before the third day?
options: Sanctify themselves and wash their clothes
Fast and pray in the camp
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctify themselves and wash their clothes
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:10 instructs Moses to tell the people to sanctify themselves and wash their clothes today and tomorrow, and Exodus 19:11 emphasizes they must be ready for the third day when the LORD will come down.

questions.question: What warning does Exodus 19:12 give regarding approaching Mount Sinai?
options: Do not go up into the mount or touch its border under penalty of death
Only priests may enter the mount at any time
Everyone should offer sacrifices before approaching
The mount is safe to climb but must be respected
questions.correctAnswer: Do not go up into the mount or touch its border under penalty of death
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:12 clearly commands setting bounds around the mount and warns that anyone who goes up or touches the mount's border shall be put to death, emphasizing holiness and reverence.

questions.question: Based on Exodus 19:13, what is the consequence for any beast or man that touches Mount Sinai?
options: They shall be stoned or shot through and shall not live
They shall be exiled from the camp
They shall offer a sacrifice for forgiveness
They shall be forgiven if they repent
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be stoned or shot through and shall not live
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:13 states no hand shall touch the mount except those appointed, and whoever does will be stoned or shot through, whether beast or man, emphasizing the seriousness of approaching God's holiness improperly.

questions.question: How does Exodus 19:15 teach about obedience and holiness in the context of preparing for God's coming?
options: The people were told not to come near their wives to maintain purity
The people were told to fast for three days
The people were instructed to build a tabernacle
The people were told to confess their sins publicly
questions.correctAnswer: The people were told not to come near their wives to maintain purity
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:15 commands the people to be ready by the third day and specifically instructs them not to come near their wives, indicating a call to maintain ritual purity and reverence before God's appearance.

questions.question: What natural phenomena accompanied the LORD's descent on Mount Sinai on the third day as described in Exodus 19:16?
options: Thunders, lightnings, a thick cloud, and a loud trumpet blast
A gentle rain and a soft breeze
A bright star appearing in the sky
questions.correctAnswer: Thunders, lightnings, a thick cloud, and a loud trumpet blast
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:16 describes thunders, lightnings, a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of a very loud trumpet, causing all the people to tremble, illustrating God's majestic presence.

questions.question: In Exodus 19:17, why did Moses bring the people out of the camp to stand at the nether part of the mount?
options: To meet with God and witness His presence
To rest before continuing their journey
To offer sacrifices to the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: To meet with God and witness His presence
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:17 explains Moses bringing the people out to meet with God, positioning them at the foot of the mount to experience God's revelation while maintaining the required distance for their safety.

questions.question: According to Exodus 19:18, what happened to Mount Sinai when the LORD descended upon it?
options: It was covered with smoke and quaked greatly
questions.correctAnswer: It was covered with smoke and quaked greatly
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:18 states that Mount Sinai was wholly on smoke because the LORD descended in fire, with smoke like a furnace and the whole mountain trembling, demonstrating God's powerful presence.

questions.question: How does Exodus 19:11-12 together emphasize the importance of readiness and boundaries in approaching God?
options: People must sanctify themselves and maintain strict boundaries around the mount for safety
People are encouraged to freely climb the mount
Boundaries are symbolic and may be ignored if one is faithful
God will come down quietly without warning
questions.correctAnswer: People must sanctify themselves and maintain strict boundaries around the mount for safety
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:11 instructs readiness for the third day, and 19:12 commands setting bounds around the mount with the warning of death for trespassers, teaching preparation and reverence toward God’s holiness.

questions.question: What does Exodus 19:14-15 teach about the practical steps for holiness before encountering God?
options: Sanctifying the people, washing clothes, and refraining from marital relations
Preparing sacrifices and fasting for three days
Building an altar and gathering incense
Publicly confessing sins and anointing with oil
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctifying the people, washing clothes, and refraining from marital relations
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:14 shows Moses sanctifying the people and their washing clothes, while 19:15 commands them to abstain from their wives, indicating ritual purity and holiness before God's presence.

questions.question: In the context of Exodus 19:13, what does the warning about stoning or shooting anyone who touches the mount teach about God's holiness and human approach?
options: God’s holiness is absolute, requiring strict separation and respect
The people are allowed to approach God anytime
God’s presence is casual and informal
Only the Levites are forbidden from approaching
questions.correctAnswer: God’s holiness is absolute, requiring strict separation and respect
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:13’s severe penalty for touching the mount underscores the absolute holiness of God and the necessity for humans to approach Him with reverence and boundaries.

questions.question: True or False: According to Exodus 19:16, the people in the camp were calm and unafraid during the LORD's descent upon Mount Sinai.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:16 states that all the people in the camp trembled because of the thunders, lightnings, thick cloud, and the loud trumpet, showing their fear and awe.

questions.question: True or False: Exodus 19:18 describes Mount Sinai as smoking and shaking because the LORD descended upon it in fire.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:18 explicitly says Mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke because the LORD descended in fire, and the mountain quaked greatly, indicating God's powerful presence.

questions.question: True or False: Exodus 19:15 encourages the people to come near their wives as a sign of celebration before meeting God.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:15 instructs the people not to come at their wives, emphasizing purity and readiness before encountering God.

questions.question: What practical lesson about holiness and preparation can Christians learn from the instructions in Exodus 19:10-14?
options: Holiness involves intentional sanctification and cleansing before meeting God
Preparation is unnecessary as God accepts everyone anytime
Only priests need to prepare for God's presence
Physical cleanliness alone is sufficient for holiness
questions.correctAnswer: Holiness involves intentional sanctification and cleansing before meeting God
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:10-14 shows God instructing Moses to sanctify the people and have them wash their clothes, teaching intentional preparation and purity before God's presence.

questions.question: Based on Exodus 19:12-13, what does the strict boundary and penalty teach about the reverence due to God?
options: God must be approached with fear and respect, observing holy boundaries
God’s presence is open and casual for all
The penalty was symbolic and not enforced
Only animals were forbidden from touching the mount
questions.correctAnswer: God must be approached with fear and respect, observing holy boundaries
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:12-13 warns that touching Mount Sinai will result in death, emphasizing reverence, fear of the LORD, and the need to observe His holy boundaries.

hard.title: Exodus Chapter 19 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Exodus Chapter 19.

questions.question: What event is described as happening when the voice of the trumpet sounded long and waxed louder and louder?
options: Moses spoke and God answered him by a voice
The people broke through to gaze upon the LORD
The people were allowed to ascend Mount Sinai
questions.correctAnswer: Moses spoke and God answered him by a voice
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:19 states that when the trumpet sounded long and waxed louder, Moses spoke and God answered him by a voice. This signifies direct communication between God and Moses.

questions.question: Where did the LORD come down upon, and whom did He call to the top of the mount?
questions.correctAnswer: Mount Sinai; Moses
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:20 describes the LORD coming down upon Mount Sinai and calling Moses to the top of the mount, highlighting the unique role of Moses as mediator.

questions.question: What instruction did the LORD give Moses concerning the people and their approach to Him?
options: Charge the people lest they break through to gaze and many perish
Allow the people to come up freely to the LORD
Tell the people to build an altar before the mount
Command the people to bring offerings
questions.correctAnswer: Charge the people lest they break through to gaze and many perish
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:21 commands Moses to charge the people not to break through to gaze upon the LORD, warning that many would perish if they did, emphasizing God's holiness and the danger of approaching improperly.

questions.question: According to Exodus 19, why must the priests sanctify themselves?
options: Lest the LORD break forth upon them
To prepare for the Passover feast
questions.correctAnswer: Lest the LORD break forth upon them
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:22 instructs the priests to sanctify themselves to avoid the LORD breaking forth upon them, underscoring the need for ritual purity when approaching God.

questions.question: What reason did Moses give to the LORD for why the people could not come up to Mount Sinai?
options: Because God charged to set bounds about the mount and sanctify it
Because the people were not yet ready spiritually
Because the mountain was too steep
questions.correctAnswer: Because God charged to set bounds about the mount and sanctify it
questions.explanation: In Exodus 19:23, Moses tells the LORD that the people cannot come up because God had commanded setting bounds and sanctifying the mount, indicating the sacredness and danger of the area.

questions.question: Who did the LORD permit to ascend Mount Sinai with Moses?
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:24 states that the LORD told Moses he and Aaron could come up the mount, but not the priests or the people, delineating a special priestly access.

questions.question: What did Moses do after receiving the instructions from the LORD about the mount and the people?
options: Went down unto the people and spoke unto them
Built an altar at the foot of the mountain
questions.correctAnswer: Went down unto the people and spoke unto them
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:25 records Moses going down and speaking to the people after receiving divine instructions, fulfilling his mediatory role between God and Israel.

questions.question: True or False: The thick cloud upon Mount Sinai was a sign for the people to prepare to hear God speak.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:9 mentions that the LORD came in a thick cloud so the people might hear when He spoke with Moses and believe him forever, marking the cloud as a divine sign.

questions.question: True or False: Moses instructed the people to come to the mountain with their wives during the third day of preparation.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:15 clearly instructs the people not to come at their wives during the third day, indicating a time of ritual purity and separation.

questions.question: Which Old Testament passage echoes the theme of God carrying His people on 'eagles' wings' as mentioned in Exodus 19?
questions.correctAnswer: Deuteronomy 32:11
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 32:11 uses the imagery of an eagle stirring up its nest to describe God's care for Israel, paralleling Exodus 19:4 where God says He bore Israel on eagles' wings.

questions.question: How does the concept of 'a kingdom of priests and a holy nation' in Exodus 19:6 connect to the New Testament teaching in 1 Peter 2:9?
options: Both describe the people of God as a royal priesthood and holy nation
They contradict each other on God's chosen people
Exodus refers to Israel only, while 1 Peter excludes Israel
1 Peter focuses on priests alone, Exodus on kings
questions.correctAnswer: Both describe the people of God as a royal priesthood and holy nation
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:6 calls Israel a kingdom of priests and a holy nation; 1 Peter 2:9 applies this identity to New Testament believers, showing continuity in God's people as a spiritual priesthood.

questions.question: What literary device is prominently used in the description of Mount Sinai's smoke ascending as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaking (Exodus 19:18)?
questions.correctAnswer: Simile
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:18 uses simile comparing the smoke of Sinai to the smoke of a furnace, creating vivid imagery of God's presence and power.

questions.question: What is the significance of sanctifying the people and instructing them to wash their clothes before the LORD comes down on Mount Sinai (Exodus 19:10-14)?
options: To prepare them ceremonially and physically for the holy encounter
To mark the beginning of the Sabbath
To purify them from dietary laws
questions.correctAnswer: To prepare them ceremonially and physically for the holy encounter
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:10-14 shows sanctification and washing as preparation for God's descent, emphasizing holiness and purity before divine revelation.

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word translated as 'sanctify' (קדש, qadosh) in this chapter primarily mean in its cultural context?
options: To set apart as holy or consecrated
questions.correctAnswer: To set apart as holy or consecrated
questions.explanation: The Hebrew root קדש (qadosh) means to be set apart or made holy, which in Exodus 19 refers to ritual and moral consecration before God.

questions.question: How does the setting of boundaries around Mount Sinai in Exodus 19:12-13 reflect ancient Near Eastern cultural practices regarding sacred spaces?
options: It reflects the common practice of delimiting holy places to prevent profanation and death for trespassers
It was unique to Israel and had no parallel elsewhere
It was a legal boundary for taxation purposes
It was intended to control wildlife only
questions.correctAnswer: It reflects the common practice of delimiting holy places to prevent profanation and death for trespassers
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:12-13 sets strict boundaries with death penalty for violation, paralleling ancient Near Eastern customs of protecting sacred precincts to maintain divine purity and order.

theological.title: Exodus Chapter 19 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Exodus Chapter 19 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What divine attribute is primarily demonstrated in God's statement, 'Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings'?
questions.correctAnswer: God's mercy and deliverance
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:4 reveals God's mercy and deliverance in bringing Israel out of Egypt and caring for them as a protective eagle carries its young.

questions.question: According to Exodus 19:5, what is the condition for Israel to be considered God's 'peculiar treasure'?
options: If they build altars and offer sacrifices
If they obey God's voice and keep His covenant
If they conquer the promised land
If they remain in the wilderness
questions.correctAnswer: If they obey God's voice and keep His covenant
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:5 makes clear that Israel's status as God's treasured possession depends on their obedience and covenant faithfulness.

questions.question: What theological doctrine is highlighted by the verse stating, 'And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation'?
options: Doctrine of the priesthood of all believers
questions.correctAnswer: Doctrine of the priesthood of all believers
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:6 teaches the doctrine that the entire people of God are set apart as a holy nation, serving priestly functions, foreshadowing the New Testament priesthood of all believers (cf. 1 Peter 2:9).

questions.question: What is the purpose of God coming 'in a thick cloud' as described in Exodus 19:9?
options: To terrify the people and cause them to flee
So the people may hear God speak to Moses and believe him forever
questions.correctAnswer: So the people may hear God speak to Moses and believe him forever
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:9 shows God's intent to authenticate Moses' prophetic authority by manifesting Himself in a cloud so all hear and believe Moses' words.

questions.question: How does the command to 'sanctify them' and 'let them wash their clothes' before God’s descent in Exodus 19:10-14 relate to the doctrine of sanctification?
options: It illustrates ceremonial purification as a symbol of moral holiness
It requires physical bathing only with no spiritual meaning
It is a punishment for sin
It is a test of obedience without spiritual significance
questions.correctAnswer: It illustrates ceremonial purification as a symbol of moral holiness
questions.explanation: The ritual washing and sanctification in Exodus 19:10-14 symbolize the people's need to be made holy and pure before encountering the holy God, teaching sanctification as preparation for divine fellowship.

questions.question: What warning is given about approaching Mount Sinai in Exodus 19:12-13, and what does it reveal about God's holiness?
options: Approach with offerings to gain favor
Do not touch or ascend the mountain lest you die, revealing God's absolute holiness and the danger of unmediated access
Everyone is invited to climb freely
questions.correctAnswer: Do not touch or ascend the mountain lest you die, revealing God's absolute holiness and the danger of unmediated access
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:12-13 emphasizes God's inviolable holiness by forbidding touching or ascending the mountain, showing that sinful humans cannot approach God without mediation.

questions.question: What is the significance of the instruction in Exodus 19:15 where the people were told 'come not at your wives' before God's appearance?
options: To demonstrate ritual purity and separation before God's holy encounter
questions.correctAnswer: To demonstrate ritual purity and separation before God's holy encounter
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:15 reflects the requirement for ritual purity and separation, symbolizing holiness and readiness before God's manifest presence.

questions.question: How does the description of Mount Sinai 'altogether on a smoke' and 'the whole mount quaked greatly' in Exodus 19:18 reveal God's attribute?
questions.correctAnswer: God’s omnipotence and awe-inspiring presence
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:18 reveals God's overwhelming power and majestic presence as the mountain is enveloped in smoke and quakes, demonstrating His omnipotence.

questions.question: What theological insight is gained from the combined teaching of Exodus 19:5-6 and Exodus 19:11 about Israel's relationship with God?
options: Israel is chosen to be a political empire
Israel must obey and sanctify themselves to meet God’s holy presence as a treasured and priestly nation
Israel will be free from all trials
Israel is called to worship many gods
questions.correctAnswer: Israel must obey and sanctify themselves to meet God’s holy presence as a treasured and priestly nation
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:5-6 and 19:11 together teach that Israel’s election as a holy nation and kingdom of priests requires obedience and sanctification to stand before God’s presence on Sinai.

questions.question: How does the instruction in Exodus 19:21-24 about Moses and Aaron ascending alone illustrate the doctrine of mediation?
options: It shows all people can approach God equally
It demonstrates that only appointed mediators may approach God to prevent judgment on the people
It encourages rebellion against God’s commands
It shows God’s indifference to human sin
questions.correctAnswer: It demonstrates that only appointed mediators may approach God to prevent judgment on the people
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:21-24 teaches the necessity of mediation as Moses and Aaron alone ascend, protecting the people from God's wrath, prefiguring Christ as mediator (1 Timothy 2:5).

questions.question: What apologetic response does Exodus 19:16-19 provide against sceptics claiming that the biblical account of God’s revelation is mere myth or legend?
options: It shows a vague and unclear event
It describes a detailed and specific physical manifestation with thunder, lightning, cloud, and trumpet, supporting a real historical theophany
It admits the event never happened
It offers no evidence for divine revelation
questions.correctAnswer: It describes a detailed and specific physical manifestation with thunder, lightning, cloud, and trumpet, supporting a real historical theophany
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:16-19 records an extraordinary sensory event authenticating God’s presence, countering sceptical claims by affirming the historicity and reality of divine revelation.

questions.question: What narrative arc connection does Exodus 19:1-2 provide for the broader redemptive story of Scripture?
options: It marks Israel’s entrance into the wilderness and preparation for covenant, highlighting God’s ongoing deliverance and covenant mediation
It describes Israel’s defeat in Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: It marks Israel’s entrance into the wilderness and preparation for covenant, highlighting God’s ongoing deliverance and covenant mediation
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:1-2 situates Israel at Sinai after deliverance, poised for covenant relationship, advancing the narrative of redemption through God’s covenant with His people.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal teaching about God's covenant faithfulness and human responsibility is revealed by Exodus 19:8 and 19:14?
options: The people’s unanimous acceptance of God’s words demands their sanctification and readiness to meet God
God forces obedience without human consent
questions.correctAnswer: The people’s unanimous acceptance of God’s words demands their sanctification and readiness to meet God
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:8 records Israel's verbal commitment, and 19:14 shows their act of sanctification, illustrating the interplay of human response and preparation in covenant relationship.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is most prominently displayed in Exodus 19:20 where the LORD calls Moses up the mount?
questions.correctAnswer: God’s transcendence and holiness
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:20 shows God's transcendence by calling Moses alone to the mount's summit, highlighting His supreme holiness and the need for mediated revelation.

questions.question: How does the command to set boundaries around Mount Sinai (Exodus 19:12) contribute to the biblical understanding of sin and God's holiness?
options: It minimizes the seriousness of sin
It symbolizes the separation needed between sinful humanity and a holy God, emphasizing that sin cannot approach God unmediated
It encourages casual access to God
It shows God’s indifference to human actions
questions.correctAnswer: It symbolizes the separation needed between sinful humanity and a holy God, emphasizing that sin cannot approach God unmediated
questions.explanation: Exodus 19:12 illustrates the strict separation due to God's holiness, teaching that sinful humans must not approach God without purification and mediation.
